name: Tulip-tree Beauty
desc: Tulip-tree Beauty (Epimecis hortaria): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Epimecis hortaria, the tulip-tree beauty, is a moth species of the Ennominae subfamily found in North America. It is found throughout New England south to Florida and west to Texas and Missouri.
